dialogues.speaker: Zheleznov
dialogues.text: I met him a few times at banquets long ago. Back then, he was full of drive, proud and confident, as though he were about to ascend to the throne of the world.

dialogues.speaker: Zheleznov
dialogues.text: And now, he is disheartened and dejected, as though he has been cast aside like an old shoe...

dialogues.speaker: Zheleznov
dialogues.text: But who can say whether a falcon that has fallen to the depths might not catch the wind once more and soar back into the sky?

dialogues.speaker: Zheleznov
dialogues.text: Knyazev's father entrusted him to my care, and instructed me that when his son finds his courage again, I'm to become his teacher and show him how to contend with the cunning serpents in the world of business.

dialogues.speaker: Zheleznov
dialogues.text: But, my friend... my young Knyazev. I do not wish to see your empty heart wholly occupied by petty calculations of profit and loss. Before that happens, it should have room for far more beautiful things.
